final: WITH race_names AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS standings_count FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(standings_count) AS avg_count FROM race_names) SELECT AVG(race_names.avg_points), AVG(race_names.standings_count), AVG(race_names.standings_count - overall.avg_count) FROM race_names CROSS JOIN overall WHERE race_names.standings_count > overall.avg_count
